brand_notes: HUMAN Speakers: one-person New Hampshire builder (Huw Powell) making own drivers, EPI-style bookshelves; all systems nominally 6 ohm per specs page (mfr-human-speakers-81-dk). ASR found crossover and driver-resonance problems in the 81 dk. 81 DK is 18.5 in tall, marginally above the ~18 in guideline; included with a note.
takeaways: ASR: LW ±4.5 dB, peak/dip/resonance at crossover, weak tweeter above 5 kHz; not recommended
Measured sensitivity 85.4 dB vs maker 89 dB/1 W (about 90.3 dB at 2.83 V, 6 Ω): 4.9 dB gap
Min impedance 4.2 Ω at 113 Hz (below IEC floor for 6 Ω)
High distortion at 96 dB; very wide dispersion (148 deg horizontal); no critic or owner reviews found
